spec.title: Refactor festina-scope deep research to use reconnaissance-first approach
spec.context:
Deep research mode currently spawns 4 broad agents (Product Context Researcher, Pattern Finder, Codebase Analyzer, Pitfall Detector) immediately that explore the entire codebase. This wastes context on irrelevant areas, takes too long, and lacks common sense about what actually needs researching. The agents do not leverage the affects and engineering fields already populated by festina-create - they search blindly instead of reading referenced docs first.
The value is faster, more focused research that uses context efficiently. Smarter targeting means discovering related areas that matter while skipping irrelevant ones.

in-scope.item: Refactor the deep research branch (lines 154-273) in festina-scope SKILL.md
Add a sequential reconnaissance phase before agent spawning
Implement dynamic agent selection based on recon findings
Update agent prompts to include focused context from recon

out-of-scope.item: Quick research path - already works correctly with affects/engineering fields
Changes to synthesize_research or resolve_pitfalls steps

requirements.requirement: The skill shall perform a sequential reconnaissance phase that reads docs referenced in the task's affects and engineering fields before spawning any agents
The recon phase shall output structured data indicating which areas need deeper exploration, with focus terms/files and boundaries for each area
The skill shall dynamically spawn only the agents needed based on recon findings (e.g., skip Pattern Finder if no engineering docs exist)
Agent prompts shall include focused context from recon: specific files to examine, grep patterns to use, and areas to skip
The skill shall maintain the same output format (research synthesis) so downstream steps remain unchanged

file.reason: Contains the deep research branch to refactor

patterns.pattern: Quick research path - uses affects/engineering fields correctly as starting point. Model for recon phase.
Problem-type-driven agent selection - spawns different agents based on problem classification rather than fixed set.
Subagent best practices: forked contexts for noisy work, clean summaries returned to orchestrator, pre-focused prompts with specific files/terms/boundaries.

product.finding: Documents the scope task feature - four-area research (product docs, engineering patterns, codebase analysis, pitfall detection) followed by technical Q&A is the core flow.

engineering.finding: No engineering docs directly referenced in task. Handlebars templating used for skill partials.
